errors.chat_unavailable: chats are not available on this instance, so an agent cannot record
errors.forbidden_admin_only: only an admin can do this
errors.forbidden_delete_on_project: this environment belongs to a project: delete it from the project page
errors.forbidden_no_init_script: the project has no init script, so its Sandbox cannot come up
errors.forbidden_no_preview_port: none of the project's init script ports is one a sandbox exposes
errors.forbidden_no_url: this environment has no URL yet
errors.forbidden_production: this is a production environment: only an admin can change it
errors.forbidden_repo_not_github: the project's repository is not on GitHub, so deploys cannot trigger runs
errors.forbidden_sandbox_fixed: a project's Sandbox cannot be deleted, renamed or scheduled
errors.forbidden_sandbox_no_record: recording on a Sandbox is not offered: record on an environment with a URL
errors.forbidden_viewer: viewers can look but not change anything
errors.no_agent: no agent in this workspace has the chat stage, which recording needs; add it to one in Agents
errors.no_auth_store: keys are not available on this instance
errors.recording_chat_only: only the agent of a recording chat can use this
errors.runner_create: create the evidence runner of batch {batch}
errors.runner_only: only the runner of this batch can use this
errors.runner_start: start the evidence runner of batch {batch}
errors.schedule_invalid: the schedule is not a valid cron expression or time zone
errors.secret_not_found: the environment has no test login called {name}
errors.unavailable: evidence is not available on this instance

log.detach_failed: keep the evidence of project {project} before deleting it
log.drop_recording_chat_failed: delete chat {chat} of a recording that did not start
log.sandbox_fetch_failed: fetch branch {branch} of project {project} for a Sandbox batch; using what the clone has

recording.howto: Use the octopus-evidence-library skill: explore the app, film the flow with evidence_start … evidence_finish, check each expected result with evidence_verify, and save once with evidence_save_case. Do not change real data.
recording.secrets: Test logins available, typed with browser_type(secret="NAME"): {names}.

reasons.deadline: the batch ran past its time limit
